title: Guidelines for packing, stowage and securing of cargo inside the freight containers, Part 1 General cargo
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 1 ) gives guidelines for safe packing, stowage and securing of general cargo in a freight container.
clause_3_terminology: stowage and securing of cargo inside the freight containers

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
